activities.title: PARKOUR
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the summary of the text using the list of words A-M below.

questions.text: Parkour is an activity that involves (9) _____ in many different ways...
questions.explanation: 9 = H (moving)

questions.text: People who practise parkour are called (10) _____.
questions.explanation: 10 = M (traceurs)

questions.text: They believe that parkour is not a sport and can never be part of a (11) _____.
questions.explanation: 11 = C (competition)

questions.text: The values of parkour are adaptability, (12) _____ and freedom.
questions.explanation: 12 = E (creativity)

questions.text: overcoming (13) _____.
questions.explanation: 13 = B (barriers)

questions.text: many feel that this (14) _____ with the values of the discipline.
questions.explanation: 14 = D (conflicts)

questions.text: However, it is more about (15) _____ development than parkour...
questions.explanation: 15 = I (personal)

activities.title: UNUSUAL SPORTS
activities.questionsInstruction: Answer True, False or Not Given to these questions about the text.

questions.text: People play bossaball on a soft surface.
questions.explanation: 'inflatable pitch' = sân bơm hơi (bề mặt êm/mềm)

questions.text: Buzkashi is an Olympic sport.
questions.explanation: Họ chỉ đang 'hy vọng' (hope to get status), chưa phải là môn thi đấu chính thức.

questions.text: Kabaddi is often played in schools.
questions.explanation: Bài chỉ nói tương tự trò 'tag' của học sinh, không nhắc liệu Kabaddi có được chơi trong trường không.

questions.text: Iepe Rubingh invented chess boxing.
questions.explanation: Chỉ nói Iepe Rubingh giành chiến thắng giải đầu tiên năm 2003, không khẳng định ông phát minh ra.

questions.text: Iepe Rubingh is from Germany.
questions.explanation: Bài nói: 'won by a Dutchman' (người Hà Lan), không phải Đức.

questions.text: People consider roshambo a serious sport.
questions.explanation: 'taken so seriously: there's a World Rock Paper Scissors Society...'

activities.title: PARKOUR
activities.questionsInstruction: Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN

questions.text: You have to use a limited number of moves in parkour.
questions.explanation: Bài ghi: 'There are NO limits on how you move...'

questions.text: Parkour is mainly done in the countryside.
questions.explanation: Bài viết không đề cập đến việc chủ yếu tập ở nông thôn.

questions.text: Parkour began in the twentieth century.
questions.explanation: Ra đời vào những năm 1980 (thuộc thế kỷ 20).

questions.text: The Yamakasi did not allow latecomers.
questions.explanation: 'Members had to arrive on time' -> Không chấp nhận người đến muộn.

questions.text: When doing parkour, Raymond Belle recommends that you always choose the easier route.
questions.explanation: Lời khuyên: 'always take the MORE DIFFICULT ONE.'

questions.text: There are many gyms in France where you can do parkour.
questions.explanation: Chỉ nói 'there are some gyms' nói chung, không nhắc ở Pháp có nhiều phòng tập hay không.

questions.text: The founder of parkour was a very good teacher of parkour.
questions.explanation: Người sáng lập từ chối dạy người khác ('refused to teach'), không đánh giá là giáo viên giỏi hay dở.

questions.text: Freerunning and parkour are similar.
questions.explanation: 'There are more similarities than differences between the two activities'

activities.title: BECOME RICH AND FAMOUS THROUGH THE INTERNET
activities.questionsInstruction: Do the following statements agree with the claims of the writer of the passage? Write YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

questions.text: Before the internet, you didn't need any special skills to become famous.
questions.explanation: Bài viết nêu: 'In the past, to become famous you needed a talent...'

questions.text: If you choose a specialist subject, you are more likely to get known.
questions.explanation: Bài không so sánh xác suất nổi tiếng khi chọn chủ đề chuyên sâu.

questions.text: Having your own blog is an excellent way to find fame.
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối: 'Creating your own blog is possibly the best way to become internet famous...'

questions.text: You can get famous easily through Facebook.
questions.explanation: Bài nói Facebook tốt để kiếm tiền, 'not for those who want to be famous' và danh tiếng khó kéo dài.

questions.text: It is not worth the effort needed to get famous through Twitter.
questions.explanation: Bài không đề cập đến việc có đáng tốn công sức hay không.

questions.text: Learning to make 'vines' could help you, if you are aiming to become famous.
questions.explanation: Bài ghi: 'Learn to create 'vines'... you can achieve the fame you've always dreamed of.'

activities.title: FAMOUS ANIMALS
activities.questionsInstruction: Do the following statements agree with the claims of the writer in the reading passage? Write YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

questions.text: All animals are very much the same.
questions.explanation: Đoạn A: 'Like people, animals each have their own personality and talents.'

questions.text: There are many different reasons why animals might be remembered.
questions.explanation: Đoạn A: 'Some of them become famous through films... others through their work...'

questions.text: Ueno died after a long illness.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'Ueno died suddenly while he was at work.'

questions.text: After some time, the people who worked at the railway station were kind to Hachiko.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'gradually people understood his loyalty and began giving him food and treats.'

questions.text: The songs written about Knut were very popular.
questions.explanation: Bài chỉ nói có bài hát viết về Knut, không đề cập chúng có phổ biến hay không.

questions.text: Knut had a happy life because of his fame.
questions.explanation: Đoạn C: 'Knut suffered in his short life without his mother...'

questions.text: The Adamsons made money from Elsa.
questions.explanation: Bài không đề cập việc gia đình Adamson kiếm tiền từ Elsa.

questions.text: The Born Free Foundation does useful work.
questions.explanation: Đoạn D: 'The Foundation's important work includes improving conditions...'

questions.text: Famous animals get many advantages from their fame.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'it is humans and not the animals themselves who benefit from that fame.'

activities.title: SOCIAL MEDIA AND THE MEANING OF FRIENDSHIP
activities.questionsInstruction: Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage for each answer.

questions.text: What has enabled people to have more friends than in the past, according to some people?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: 'with the explosion of social media since then, many people now have over 300 people...'

questions.text: What phrase does the writer use to describe people who don't stay in the same place?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: 'People are in general more geographically mobile nowadays.'

questions.text: What work-related problem do people have that makes them less likely to form friendships?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: 'People now have less security at work and this also means that they find it harder to build new relationships.'

questions.text: What frequently influences the friendships of young children?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'Young children often choose their friends because of convenience...'

questions.text: What are people with friends less likely to suffer from?
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối: 'People who spend time with friends have fewer mental health problems...'
